subject: Sunrise schedule: regional security reviewer sessions for private deployment demo
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@aurora-biotech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcel Dupont <marcel.dupont@aurora-biotech.eu>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@aurora-biotech.jp>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: private deploy demo + EU DPO / APAC security review

Hi Marcus —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Aurora is preparing a Dedicated/Private deployment proof-of-concept and we need a stakeholder session that includes our EU DPO (Marcel) and APAC security lead (Kenji). Two asks:

1) Can Redwood run the demo + security walkthrough with the regional reviewers in the room? They want to validate data residency, KMS/HSM approach, and audit logging.
2) Because of recent DST changes across regions, we need explicit timezones on invites and ideally two shorter regional blocks rather than one long session so reviewers aren’t joining at 3am local.

Proposed windows (we tried to pick overlaps):
- Option A: Tue Apr 20 — EU block 14:00–15:00 CEST (UTC+2); APAC block Tue Apr 20 21:00–21:45 JST (UTC+9) — this keeps an overlap with US early morning.
- Option B: Split across two days with a 30-minute exec overlap: EU 14:00–15:00 CEST Thu Apr 22; APAC 09:30–10:15 SGT Fri Apr 23 (would avoid late-night on APAC side).

Attached our baseline "Aurora must-haves" doc so Redwood can prepare the checklist. Marcel and Kenji, please flag constraints.

Thanks,
Ellen
Ellen Park
Director, Cloud Platforms
Aurora Biotech
(attachment: aurora-must-haves.docx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@aurora-biotech.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: private deploy demo + EU DPO / APAC security review

Ellen — appreciated, and thanks for the doc.

High level: we can do either a single session with the reviewers joined for a dedicated security segment, or split into two shorter regional blocks with an optional 30-min overlap for execs. Splitting usually reduces review fatigue and lets us tailor deep technical artifacts per region.

Soojin / Lauren / Priyom — can you confirm availability and whether Redwood should bring:
- redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf (security checklist) — I can attach for Marcel/Kenji
- a short internal run-through the day before (30m) to align demos and handoffs

Prelim availability from our side (PT / converted):
- Tue Apr 20: 08:00–11:00 PDT (that maps to 17:00–20:00 CEST / 00:00–03:00 JST) — not ideal for APAC.
- Thu Apr 22: 07:00–10:00 PDT (16:00–19:00 CEST / 23:00–02:00 JST) — still late for APAC.
- Fri Apr 23 morning PT we could prioritize APAC-friendly times if we split.

I recommend we: (1) confirm whether Aurora prefers same-day split (two blocks on the same date) vs two-day split with overlap, (2) decide the overlap length (I suggest 30 min), and (3) lock reviewers' preferred local windows.

I'll hold off on calendar invites until we have firm windows.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen@aurora-biotech.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 12:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: private deploy demo + EU DPO / APAC security review

Thanks — quick notes from Security side (Soojin):

- EU DPO (Marcel) prefers 14:00–17:00 CEST weekdays. Within that window he can block 14:00–15:00 for a focused security walkthrough.
- APAC (Kenji) is in JST/SGT; he typically blocks 09:30–12:30 local for deep reviews but will not do sessions after 22:00 JST.

Given the constraints, our recommendation: split into two regional sessions on consecutive days with a 30-minute leadership overlap at the start of the EU block to allow execs from Aurora and Redwood to join live. Proposed schedule (concrete):

- EU session: Thu Apr 22, 14:00–15:15 CEST — attendees: Marcel (DPO), Aurora security, Redwood Security (Soojin), Solutions Eng (Lauren). We will run the deployment walkthrough (30m), KMS/HSM and audit logs deep-dive (30m), Q&A (15m).
- APAC session: Fri Apr 23, 09:30–10:15 SGT — attendees: Kenji (APAC Sec), Aurora APAC security, Redwood Solutions (Priyom), short replay of config differences (20m) + Q&A (10m).
- Exec overlap: Thu Apr 22, 14:00–14:30 CEST — this time equals 05:00–05:30 PDT / 12:00–12:30 SGT (Kenji could join midday if needed), so Kenji would instead join the dedicated APAC session.

I attached our internal checklist (redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf) to show what we'll prepare for each block. If Aurora prefers same-day split we can try compressing but risk APAC joining very late.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Security Reviews, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf)

From: Ellen Park <ellen@aurora-biotech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcel Dupont <marcel.dupont@aurora-biotech.eu>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@aurora-biotech.jp>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: private deploy demo + EU DPO / APAC security review

All — thanks for the proposal, Soojin. Two-day split with the 30-minute exec overlap works best for Aurora. Confirming:

- EU session: Thu Apr 22, 14:00–15:15 CEST — Marcel + Aurora EU security team will attend.
- APAC session: Fri Apr 23, 09:30–10:15 SGT — Kenji + Aurora APAC security will attend.
- Please send calendar invites with times shown in each attendee's local timezone and include the agenda (security checklist + config docs).

I'll attach our "aurora-must-haves" doc to the calendar and add Kenji/Marcel to the invite. One ask: please call out any items requiring legal sign-off vs engineering sign-off so we can route reviewers ahead of time.

Ellen

(attachment: aurora-must-haves.docx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@aurora-biotech.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marcel Dupont <marcel.dupont@aurora-biotech.eu>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@aurora-biotech.jp>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: private deploy demo + EU DPO / APAC security review — calendar & action items

Thanks everyone — calendar invites sent (links below) with explicit timezone labels. Summary/action items:

- Thu Apr 22 14:00–15:15 CEST (EU session) — Agenda: 5m intro, 30m deployment walkthrough, 30m KMS/HSM & audit logs, 10m legal/design sign-off flags, 10m Q&A. Attendees: Marcel, Aurora EU sec, Soojin, Lauren.
- Fri Apr 23 09:30–10:15 SGT (APAC session) — Agenda: 5m intro, 20m config differences & network lanes, 20m logging/retention controls, 10m Q&A. Attendees: Kenji, Aurora APAC sec, Priyom.
- Pre-run: Wed Apr 21 16:00–16:30 CEST (internal dry run) — Redwood only (Soojin, Lauren, Priyom) to rehearse handoffs and confirm slides.

Attachments included: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf, aurora-must-haves.docx
Related links: Drive folder (shared) and the two calendar invites: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=rdw-eu-session-20270422 and https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=rdw-apac-session-20270423

If Marcel or Kenji want any pre-reading flagged as legal vs engineering, reply here and we'll mark sections in the shared Drive doc.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference runtime
(attachments: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf, aurora-must-haves.docx)
